title: 🚩 Kind of People You Find in Brew Islamabad Part 1
body: A girl arranging her cup, her bag, and her hand at three different angles for the same photo, eleventh take, captioning it like she's anywhere but Islamabad. Somewhere in the building, an influencer everyone's pretending not to recognize, phone camera already up. A guy who's looked over four times and said nothing, ordering a second coffee purely to buy himself more time to build the courage. The rooftop thick with smoke and small talk, more cigarettes lit than coffees ordered. A car circling the block for the third time because the outdoor seating is gone and so, apparently, is every parking spot within walking distance.
caption:
Tag the one who's taken 40 photos at Brew for one Instagram post 😭
